copyPolicy: Original target JS and Babel implementation remain in place; no implementation copy. Owned metadata, analysis scripts and diagnostic captures only. Diagnostic exceptions are explicitly excluded from contracts in main.scope.
manifestSelfPin: This manifest does not hash itself; exact manifest pin is returned separately after freeze.
postFreezeDiagnostic: freeze-confirmation.json is produced after validating manifest and modes, excluded from files to avoid a cyclic manifest; it is separately pinned and read-only.
